content_sections.heading: OSSTET 2026 Notification Out
content_sections.text: BSE Odisha has officially notified OSSTET 2026 through Notification No. 2198/Conf-I dated 1 August 2026, along with copies forwarded to Zonal Offices, District Education Officers, Collectors, and District Magistrates for wider circulation. Step-by-step registration instructions, detailed eligibility guidelines, and the syllabus structure have been made available on the official website. Candidates should read the full notification carefully before applying, since once submitted, personal data, address, caste, and subject details cannot be changed. OSSTET Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: OSSTET 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: OSSTET does not have a fixed vacancy count or a specified age limit in the notification - it is an eligibility test whose pass certificate is a prerequisite for teacher recruitment. Eligibility instead depends on nationality, the ability to read and write Odia, and the academic/professional qualification required for the specific teaching category and subject a candidate is applying for. The candidate must be a citizen of India. Candidates must be able to read and write Odia. This can be satisfied by any one of the following: Passed HSC (or equivalent) examination with Odia as First/Second/Third Language subject, from BSE Odisha or an equivalent State/Central Board Passed +2/Higher Secondary examination conducted by the Council of Higher Secondary Education, Odisha, with Odia as an examinable subject Passed the Odia Examination of the HSC/10th Standard Single Subject Examination conducted by BSE Odisha Candidates applying to become language teachers such as Hindi Teacher or Classical Teacher (Sanskrit/Telugu/Urdu) may instead pass the Odia Examination of 7th/8th Standard conducted by BSE Odisha. OSSTET is conducted for two categories of prospective teachers: Category I (Education Teachers) and Category II (Physical Education Teacher). The academic and professional qualification required depends on the subject/stream chosen.

content_sections.heading: OSSTET 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Fee once paid is not refunded, and the Board is not responsible for non-submission of an application even if the fee payment has gone through. Payment must be made online during the registration process.

content_sections.heading: OSSTET 2026 Exam Pattern
content_sections.text: OSSTET 2026 will be conducted in two papers depending on the category chosen: Paper-I for Category I (Education Teachers) and Paper-II for Category II (Physical Education Teacher). Each paper is of 2 hours 30 minutes duration, contains multiple-choice questions worth 1 mark each with four options, and has no negative marking. Each paper is divided into four sections. Section III varies by stream: TGT (Arts) covers Odia, English, History & Political Science, and Geography & Economics (15 marks each); TGT (Science) PCM covers Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry (20 marks each); TGT (Science) CBZ covers Chemistry, Botany, and Zoology (20 marks each); and the Classical Teacher (Sanskrit/Telugu/Urdu) and Hindi Teacher streams have 60 marks dedicated entirely to the respective language. Sections I and II are the same as Paper-I (Odia and English, 20 marks each). Section III covers Physical Education with 60 questions for 60 marks, and Section IV is the same Child Development, Pedagogy, School Management & Evaluation section carrying 50 marks. Sections I (Odia) and II (English) are compulsory for all categories. In Section III, questions for TGT (Arts) and TGT (Science – PCM/CBZ) are set in English, while questions for Classical Teacher (Sanskrit/Telugu/Urdu) and Hindi Teacher are set in the respective language/script. Section III of Paper-II (Physical Education) is in English, and Section IV (Child Development, Pedagogy, School Management & Evaluation) is in English for both categories.

content_sections.heading: OSSTET 2026 Qualifying Marks
content_sections.text: The minimum pass mark in each paper is 45% (68 marks out of 150) for General category candidates, and 35% (53 marks out of 150) for SC/ST/PH/SEBC candidates. A candidate must secure at least the applicable qualifying percentage in each paper to be considered as having qualified OSSTET.

content_sections.heading: OSSTET 2026 Certificate Validity and Number of Attempts
content_sections.text: Successful candidates are awarded the OSSTET Pass Certificate by BSE Odisha. The certificate remains valid until the candidate reaches the upper age limit prescribed for teacher recruitment under applicable rules or government instructions issued from time to time. There is no restriction on the number of attempts a candidate can make to acquire the OSSTET Pass Certificate. Qualifying OSSTET is only one of the eligibility criteria for appointment as a teacher - it does not by itself confer any right to recruitment or employment in a Government or Government-Aided school; actual recruitment eligibility is determined separately by the concerned recruiting agency or appointing authority.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for OSSTET 2026
content_sections.text: OSSTET 2026 applications must be submitted online only at www.bseodisha.ac.in. The registration link is active 24×7 from 3 August 2026 to midnight of 17 August 2026. Visit www.bseodisha.ac.in and click "Click Here for New Registration", or log in with the registered mobile number and password if already registered. Enter Name, Password, Mobile Number, e-Mail ID, and Caste Category, then click "Submit". Caste details entered at this stage cannot be corrected later. Log in again using the registered mobile number and password. Enter the verification code sent to the registered mobile number and click "Verify". Proceed to pay the application fee online. Fill up the four sections of the application form in order: Personal Information, Eligibility Criteria, Educational Qualification, and Declaration. Upload all required certificates, documents, and photographs in the specified format and size. Review all filled information at the Declaration stage, make edits if necessary, and tick the declaration box. Click "YES – FINAL SUBMIT" to complete registration; no further editing is possible after this step. Download and preserve the print copy of the Acknowledgement Receipt. Registration is complete only after this receipt is downloaded; without it, the admit card cannot be generated and the candidate will not be allowed to appear for the examination.

content_sections.text: Applications are accepted online only, through www.bseodisha.ac.in. Information relating to personal data, address, caste, and subject, once submitted, cannot be changed later. If any information furnished by a candidate is found to be false or fake, the candidature or result will be cancelled, and the candidate will be liable for prosecution as per rules. Candidates must enter their own valid e-mail ID and mobile number; registration cannot be completed otherwise. faq.question: Q1. What is OSSTET 2026?
faq.answer: OSSTET 2026 is the Odisha Secondary School Teacher Eligibility Test conducted by BSE Odisha. Passing it is a mandatory eligibility requirement for appointment as a teacher in Secondary Schools (Government/Government-Aided/Recognised Unaided) in Odisha.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for OSSTET 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process closes on 17 August 2026 at midnight, and BSE Odisha has stated that this date will not be extended under any circumstances.

faq.question: Q3. When will the OSSTET 2026 exam be conducted?
faq.answer: The examination will be held on 30 September 2026, from 9:00 AM to 11:30 AM, for both Paper-I and Paper-II.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for OSSTET 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 900 per candidate for General/OBC category, and Rs. 600 per candidate for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for OSSTET 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification depends on the category and subject chosen - for example, a relevant bachelor's degree with 50% aggregate (45% for reserved categories) plus a B.Ed. or equivalent teacher training qualification for Category I streams, and a +2 pass plus a physical education diploma/degree for Category II.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualifying mark for OSSTET 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum qualifying mark is 45% (68 out of 150) for General candidates and 35% (53 out of 150) for SC/ST/PH/SEBC candidates, in each paper.

faq.question: Q7. How many papers are there in OSSTET 2026, and what is the exam pattern?
faq.answer: There are two papers: Paper-I for Category I (Education Teachers) and Paper-II for Category II (Physical Education Teacher). Each paper has 150 MCQs across four sections, a duration of 2 hours 30 minutes, and no negative marking.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply online for OSSTET 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can register online at www.bseodisha.ac.in between 3 August 2026 and 17 August 2026, complete the four-section application form, upload documents, pay the fee, and download the acknowledgement receipt after final submission.
